changelog:
- Expanded support for input parameters: added source/target language selection, subtitle display, and bilingual subtitle options.
- Target language is now limited to Chinese and English; validation checks updated accordingly.
- New support for specifying source language, with validation for supported languages (en/zh/ko/ja/fr/ru/es/de).
- Added detailed rules for subtitle handling, including support for show and bilingual options.
- Minor documentation updates and removal of the sample skill-card.md file.
